proposal: A02 six families with synchronized day/week aligned 168/336/720h blocks. Conditional donor pools chosen only using market returns/volatility/dispersion, not bot performance. Actual400bar warmup fromContext; price paths reuse known three-yearDonors into five synthetic years. No stationary-market theorem or future-probability claim.

discovery_phase.candidate_eligibility: All discovery jobs present and technically valid, median normal net profit>=baseline and median stress net profit>=baseline. Participation and worst end/DD are disclosure/feasibility metrics, never evidence of real fills.
ranking: median net profit across 12 normal paths descending
median max closing drawdown across same12normalpaths ascending

validation_phase.unlock: Write immutable Discovery-Selection.json before generating/reading validation PnL. Only selected winner versus baseline; if winner=baseline no rescue candidate.
validation_phase.improvement_claim: Paired median net profit advantage>=0 under both normal and stress, plus at least7/12 normal validation paths not worse. Report everyfamily/tailcost/worstend/DD/participation. Failure is NO_CHANGE, never rerank or expand grid.
validation_phase.independence_limit: New random seeds, same examined historical donors; NOT genuinely unknown real market evidence.

scope: Research and possible recommendations only. No running bot, source/domain strategy, APIkeys, Live activation or restart changes. No automatic promotion from synthetic evidence alone.
checks_before_performance: all15 joint sampling indices and UTC-hour/weekday alignment
distributional comparison against proper donor pools
native chronological strategy with no future provisionalbars
previous-closed-hour liquidity participation coverage and extremeequityflag
stable state across joints, no reset of positions/indicators/dayrisk
technical_faults: Evaluate separately with current fake-exchange operational tests; do not claim candle-gap modeling covers internet downtime or actual exit fills.
